title: Artificial intelligence
modelHint: Enter the API key and load the models to choose one. You can also type its identifier.
modelCatalogHint: Models available to this key. Test connection checks whether the selected model supports the text test.
modelsEmpty: The provider returned no models. You can refresh the list or enter an identifier manually.
modelsCooldown: Wait {{seconds}} seconds before requesting models again.
installationHint: One shared connection for the entire business. Each installation maintains its own configuration.
credentialHint: The saved key is never displayed or returned to the browser.
keyHint: Use the provider's API key. It is cleared from the editor after a confirmed save or when changes are discarded.
testHint: The test sends a short request to the provider and may incur a charge. It does not save changes; a successful test is not kept as permanent verification.
availableHint: Prepares the connection for features that use it in future releases.
pausedHint: Keeps the provider, model and key. Manual testing remains available.
removeHint: The connection will be paused when you save. You can discard this change before saving it.
providerChangeHint: The model and candidate key will be cleared. The previous provider's key will be removed when you save and the connection will be paused.
leaveHint: The candidate key and editor changes will be lost.
leaveUncertain: The candidate key will be lost when you leave. The save may have committed on the server; check its outcome before starting another change.
readOnly: You can view this connection. Changing or testing it requires permission to manage artificial intelligence.
savedThenChanged: Your save was confirmed. You are now viewing a later change by another administrator.
readFailed: We couldn't check the outcome. Try again.
uncertain: We couldn't confirm the save outcome. Check its receipt before saving again.
conflict: The configuration changed. Read the current revision and review your draft before saving.
missingReceipt: We haven't found the receipt yet. This does not confirm that the save failed. You can check again or retry the exact same request.

providerErrors.CredentialInvalid: The provider rejected the key. Check its permissions and validity.
providerErrors.ModelUnavailable: The model is unavailable to this key or does not support the test. Check its identifier.
providerErrors.QuotaExceeded: The provider account has no credit or has reached its quota.
providerErrors.RateLimited: The provider limited requests. Wait before testing again.
providerErrors.Busy: Other tests are running. Wait before testing again.
providerErrors.Unavailable: The provider is unavailable. Try again later.
providerErrors.ResponseInvalid: The provider returned a response we couldn't verify.
providerErrors.ResponseIncomplete: The model did not complete the test within its limit. Try another model.
providerErrors.TestUncertain: The test ended without a confirmed outcome. The provider may have processed it; check usage before repeating it.
